info.title: RoCoLe: A Robusta Coffee Leaf Images Dataset
info.subtitle: A Robusta Coffee Leaf Images Classification Dataset
info.description:
Sure, here is a dataset description for the RoCoLe coffee leaf image dataset based on the information I found on the web:

The RoCoLe: A Robusta Coffee Leaf Images Dataset is a publicly available dataset of coffee leaf images that can be used for plant disease detection and classification tasks. The dataset comprises 1560 images of Robusta coffee leaves captured under real-world conditions using a smartphone camera. The images are categorized into three classes:

1. Coffee healthy: Images of healthy coffee leaves without any signs of disease.
2. Coffee rust: Images of coffee leaves infected with coffee rust disease, which is caused by a fungus.
3. Coffee spider mites: Images of coffee leaves infested with coffee spider mites, which are small insects that can damage coffee leaves.

The dataset is useful for researchers and developers who are working on machine learning algorithms for automatic coffee leaf disease detection and classification.

Here are some additional details about the dataset:

* The images were captured under diverse real-world conditions, including variations in lighting, backgrounds, and temperature levels.
* The images have been resized and classified into folders representing the class they belong to.
* Some sources mention that the dataset also contains annotations describing objects (leaves), their state (healthy or unhealthy), and the severity of disease based on the leaf area with spots. However, it appears there is no consensus on whether these annotations are included in the publicly available version of the dataset.

If you are interested in learning more about the RoCoLe dataset, you can visit the following link: [https://datasetninja.com/rocole](https://datasetninja.com/rocole)

Reference:
>Parraga-Alava, Jorge; Cusme, Kevin; Loor, Angélica; Santander, Esneider (2019), “RoCoLe: A robusta coffee leaf images dataset ”, Mendeley Data, V2, doi: 10.17632/c5yvn32dzg.2
